day3_lunch_start.text: *At lunch, I open my desk drawer and find a note inside.*

day3_lunch_note_yuna.text: *'Sunbae, please come to the rooftop during lunch. Make sure you come alone. It's important. - Yuna'*

day3_lunch_note_yuna_2.text: *A black thread, like it came loose from a camera strap, is stuck to the bottom of the note.*

day3_lunch_note_yuna_brief.text: *'Sunbae, please come to the rooftop at lunch. There's something important. - Yuna'*

day3_lunch_note_yuna_brief_2.text: *She's the photography club junior I briefly greeted on the field. The ends of the letters are pressed down in a hurry.*

day3_lunch_note_unknown.text: *'Sunbae, please come to the rooftop during lunch. Make sure you come alone. It's important. - Yuna'*

day3_lunch_note_unknown_2.text: *Yuna. An unfamiliar name. I try to picture the class seating chart, but that square is empty.*

day3_lunch_note_unknown_3.text:
*When I fold the note, a speck of dust falls from inside the paper.*

*I put it in my pocket. The note bearing an unfamiliar name grows thin, pressed flat by my body heat.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_2.text:
*Yuna silently holds out the camera.*

This is the important thing? What am I looking for?

day3_lunch_rooftop_3.text:
*Yuna grips the camera with both hands. Her knuckles are white.*

You wouldn't believe me if I just told you. Please look.

day3_lunch_rooftop_5.text:
*I take the camera. A photo is on screen.*

Just scroll through? I'll start from the first.

day3_lunch_rooftop_6.text:
*A student with short black hair stands at the school gate. The name tag on his stiff uniform reads 'Kim Dojin'.*

Kim Dojin? Was he a transfer student too?

day3_lunch_rooftop_7.text:
*I advance the photo.*

Look at the next one too. The name tag as well.

day3_lunch_rooftop_8.text:
*Same gate, brown hair. The name tag says 'Park Seojin'.*

Park Seojin. Different name. But that face—

day3_lunch_rooftop_9.text:
*I go to the next photo.*

There are more. Keep going to the end.

day3_lunch_rooftop_10.text:
*The next photo shows a long-haired boy with a haggard face. His name tag reads 'Kim Taeho'.*

Kim Taeho. Same gate again. When was this taken?

day3_lunch_rooftop_11.text:
*I keep scrolling.*

Go all the way to the end. Don't stop halfway.

day3_lunch_rooftop_12.text: *The last photo. The school gate, yesterday morning.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_14.text:
*I check the name tag in the photo again.*

That's my name. Why are all the others different?

day3_lunch_rooftop_15.text:
*I can't put the camera down. I go back through the photos from the beginning, one at a time.*

Wait. Let me go back. Maybe I misread something—

day3_lunch_rooftop_16.text: The hair and the name tags. Don't look only at those.

day3_lunch_rooftop_17.text: The eyes, nose, mouth. All the same. Yuna, that's my face.

day3_lunch_rooftop_18.text: 13 photos. 13 name tags, and they're all me. How did you take these?

day3_lunch_rooftop_19.text:
I haven't altered the photos. Please look at me.

*Yuna watches only me without a word. Her eyes are red.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_20.text:
*The screen of the camera in my hands shakes slightly.*

So I kept coming here? I thought this was my first time.

day3_lunch_rooftop_21.text:
*I raise my eyes to Yuna. She's biting her lip. The fabric on the inside of her camera strap is frayed.*

Looking again won't change them. Please listen to me.

day3_lunch_rooftop_22.text:
*I stumble over the first syllable. The last photo stays on screen.*

Those people… where did they all go?

day3_lunch_rooftop_23.text: *Yuna speaks. Her voice is low enough to get lost in the wind.*

day3_lunch_rooftop_24.text: ...They disappear every time. A week at most.

day3_lunch_rooftop_25.text: A week at most? What do you mean, disappear? Transfer away?

day3_lunch_rooftop_27.text:
*I pull my tie, but air catches in my throat.*

Wait… I can't catch my breath.

day3_lunch_rooftop_28.text:
*Yuna shakes her head when I try to return the camera.*

Why? It's yours. Is it okay for me to keep it?

day3_lunch_rooftop_30.text:
*Moisture gathers at the ends of Yuna's lashes. She doesn't wipe it away.*

All right, I'll keep it. Are you okay?

day3_lunch_door_1.text: *The rooftop door suddenly slams shut with a bang.*

day3_lunch_door_2.text:
*I push, but it won't open.*

It's locked. From the outside.

choices: Bang hard on the door and shout

day3_lunch_door_bang.text:
Anyone there? Please open the door!

*I bang hard on the door. After 5 minutes it opens. There's nobody outside, and no padlock. No sign of who locked it.*

Yuna, you can come out. No one's here.

day3_lunch_door_wait.text:
*I hold Yuna's shoulders and calm her down. 5 minutes later, the door opens. There's nobody outside, and no padlock. No sign of who locked it.*

Slowly. Don't rush. Let me check outside… No one. No padlock either.

day3_lunch_door_open.text:
No one's here. I can't see a padlock either.

*I go down the stairs. Yuna follows behind me. Neither of us speaks.*

day3_lunch_door_open_2.text: *The sound of the camera screen flipping still lingers in my fingertips. Click. Click. Click.*

day3_lunch_door_open_3.text: *The grout lines between the stair tiles connect in squares, like the name tags in the photos.*

day3_lunch_door_open_4.text: At my old school, Minsu and I… No, wait. I can't remember the rest.

day3_lunch_door_open_5.text:
*The words came from my own mouth, yet their pronunciation sounded foreign.*

Let's walk slowly. You don't have to talk.

day3_lunch_door_open_6.text:
*I braced a hand against the wall. Saliva pooled in my mouth -- my stomach lurched. I swallowed. Bent over, I pressed my forehead to the wall. The tile was cold.*

Hold the wall. I'll stay here. You don't have to walk yet.

day3_lunch_nametag_1.text: *...My gaze drops to the name tag on my chest. My name. Three syllables I've pinned on every morning.*

day3_lunch_nametag_2.text: *It feels unfamiliar. I touch it with my fingers, but all I feel is plastic.*

day3_lunch_door_open_7.text: *The camera knocks against my thigh as I walk, its weight pulling to one side.*

day3_lunch_door_open_8.text: *As I walk down the hallway, I watch the students brushing past me. Some start to greet me, then close their mouths. Some pass by like they've never seen my face before.*

day3_lunch_door_open_9.text: Sunbae, the photos... don't show them to anyone. Especially not the teachers.

day3_lunch_door_open_11.text:
Go back to class now. Put the camera in your bag.

*We part on the 1st floor. Yuna looks at me once before turning away. My hand holding the camera pauses briefly in midair.*

day3_lunch_door_open_12.text: *I'm left alone. The hallway is long.*

day3_lunch_sea_1.text: You're eating with me today, right?

day3_lunch_sea_2.text: *Sea is smiling. The seat across from her tray has already been cleared, with an extra cup of water waiting.*

day3_lunch_sea_3.text: *I sat down across from Sea. Sea looks at my lunch tray.*

day3_lunch_sea_4.text: Today's menu looks good. {name}, you like mackerel, right.

day3_lunch_sea_5.text: I do like mackerel, but I never told you that.

choices: Pass it off as a joke

day3_lunch_sea_7.text: I saw you yesterday when you were picking side dishes. You went for the fish first.

day3_lunch_sea_8.text:
*The tips of Sea's chopsticks stop above a piece of mackerel. Her smile stays in place as she waits for my answer.*

Taking fish first doesn't mean it's my favorite.

day3_lunch_sea_9.text: ...{name}, you seem to be wandering around alone a lot lately?

day3_lunch_sea_12.text:
*Sea stops as she reaches for a side dish with her chopsticks. Her gaze stays fixed on her tray for a while.*

Why ask, then? Is there a reason I shouldn't go alone?

day3_lunch_sea_13.text:
Answer when I ask. I'm asking about you.

*It's loud all around us. At this table, the only sound is chopsticks touching plates.*

day3_lunch_sea_14.text: There's something you haven't told me, isn't there?

day3_lunch_sea_15.text:
*Sea's voice drops. The hand gripping her chopsticks presses against the edge of the tray. The piece of mackerel splits in half.*

You're keeping things back too. When you ask like that, I don't know where to start. Put the chopsticks down for a moment.

day3_lunch_sea_17.text:
*Sea smiles again but keeps watching me.*

A joke? It didn't sound like one just now.

day3_lunch_riin_1.text:
*I opened the nurse's office door. The smell of disinfectant stings my nose. Nurse Riin is standing in front of the cabinet. She turns when the door opens.*

Can I sit down for a moment? I feel a little dizzy.

day3_lunch_riin_first.text: What's wrong, {name}? You don't look well.

day3_lunch_riin_first_2.text: *It's my first time in the nurse's office, yet she calls me by name straight away. Did she see it on the attendance sheet?*

day3_lunch_riin_2.text: What's wrong, {name}? You don't look well.

day3_lunch_riin_4.text:
*Nurse Riin points to the bed, then puts her hand on my forehead as soon as I sit down. Her hand is cool.*

Stay seated. I'll check your temperature first.

day3_lunch_riin_5.text: No fever... but your complexion is bad.

day3_lunch_riin_6.text:
*Nurse Riin turns away and opens the cabinet. I can see her back. She picks up one bottle, puts it down, then takes the one beside it.*

What medicine is that? For dizziness?

day3_lunch_riin_7.text: I have an electrolyte drink. If you're dizzy, take just a sip.

day3_lunch_riin_8.text:
*Riin turns back holding a clear cup of pale purple liquid. Tiny ripples keep forming on the surface.*

Is it supposed to be that color? It doesn't look like a normal drink.

day3_lunch_riin_9.text: It's mixed with vitamins and electrolytes. It may not taste great.

day3_lunch_riin_choice.text:
*Nurse Riin smiles and holds the cup out toward me, but her other hand rests near the sink’s faucet.*

Wait a moment. Do I have to drink it?

day3_lunch_riin_drink_1.text:
*I take one sip. A bitter taste lingers under my tongue. My mouth feels slightly dry.*

Bitter. You said one sip was enough, right?

day3_lunch_riin_drink_2.text: ...You don't have to finish it. The taste is a bit much, right?

day3_lunch_riin_drink_3.text: *Nurse Riin takes the cup away. The moment she turns -- she's biting her lip hard.*

day3_lunch_riin_refuse_2.text:
*Nurse Riin takes the cup away. She pours the contents into the sink. The moment the purple liquid touches the water, it loses its color.*

Is it all right to throw it away like that? The color's gone in the water. You were telling me to drink it a moment ago.

day3_lunch_alone_1.text: *I stayed in the classroom and ate alone. Through the window, I can see the schoolyard. Kids are playing soccer.*

day3_lunch_alone_2.text: *The sounds from the field cut off at the window. Only the tip of my chopsticks scraping against the lunchbox compartment remains.*

day3_lunch_alone_3.text: *I look at the seat in the back. Seolhwa's seat. That line in the attendance book is empty again today. Only the date above the blackboard has changed for the third day.*

day3_lunch_alone_4.text: *There are pencil marks on Seolhwa's desk. Very thin writing. **'Get out of here'***

day3_lunch_alone_5.text: *The chopsticks fell from my hand. They rolled over the lunchbox lid and hit the floor. The sound rang all the way to the end of the classroom.*

day3_lunch_alone_6.text: *I run my hand over the desk surface. It's been carved deeply. It wasn't written once. Multiple times. Traces of the same words written over and over.*

day3_lunch_alone_7.text: *...The handwriting matches the one from the locker. My handwriting.*

day3_lunch_alone_8.text: *I set down my chopsticks and closed the lunchbox.*

day3_lunch_end.text: *I came back to the classroom. Even after I let go of the doorknob, the chill of metal stays in my palm.*
